set.request: add the Panel: clock element to the /framework/ page, this is badass.
steps: Read the seam: panel(), paint(), templates.clock, the landing's tracks
Decide the band: track, height, what it does at 3440
Land: log, readme, front-door console clean

links.label: The front door, with the clock

set.outcome: **The live clock is on the front door** — a full-bleed `ext/Panel` band between the code sample and the walls, ticking, with its real bar: hit `T` and the band becomes any of the other twenty-two templates. Two things came out of it. `panel()` now takes a T name (`panel("clock")`) as well as a draw function, because `panel(fn)` leaves `data.template` unset and the bar's menu was reading "blank" while a clock was drawn. And the band's height is `clamp(20em, 26vw, 48em)`, not a flat 34em: the clock is `min(17cqw, 38cqh)`, so height is what sizes it, and the flat value filled 74% of the band at 1280 but 32% at 3440. Measured 54/51/46% at 1280/1920/3440, light and dark, no console errors on /framework/, /framework/ext/Panel/ or /full/.
